text:
We are seeking a full-time CAD/BIM specialist (40 hours a week in person/on site) to support more than 30 engineers and expand our building-modeling capacity. Social skills and an attitude of service are paramount, in addition to expertise working with Autodesk AutoCAD, and Revit. We're looking for a fast learner who is enthusiastic to learn in-house custom tools, with an affinity for problem solving and the ability to think creatively. This is a nonexempt, or hourly, position.

Requirements:
We offer a competitive salary, as well as excellent benefits including: an HSA-qualified health plan; dental and vision allowance; life insurance; wage-replacement benefits for family and medical leaves of absence; professional development allowance; 401k plan with company match; paid time off (vacation, sick, and bereavement leave; 9 holidays plus the weekdays between Christmas and New Year's Day); and time off for volunteering. And we sincerely encourage a healthy work-life balance!
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law, regulation, or ordinance.
(Please note: communications from recruiters will be ignored.)
Please click HERE to apply. You’ll be asked to include a cover letter, résumé, and any work samples you feel illustrate your qualifications.
